visibleUI.method: Native app actions and accessibility/screenshot observations through cua_repl; separate CLI writer used only the synthetic workbook.
steps: Opened fresh synthetic Willow Workshop workbook and full Supplier comparison table.
Selected Oak Supply quantity in row 1; supplier ascending sort moved it to row 2 while selection and conversation context followed Oak.
Edited Oak quantity to 11; visible total became 26.4, Cedar stayed at 10 / 27.5.
Began typing 13 without committing. A separate CLI writer changed the same original row version to quantity 7.
After ending the pending edit, the app showed The workbook changed. Refresh and try again.; Oak remained 7 / 16.8 and Cedar remained 10 / 27.5.
Filtered to Cedar; the Oak selection and About context disappeared. Clearing the filter restored both rows without selecting a neighbor.
Inspected final layout and quit the preview.

limits: No new real-model performance run after table changes. The preceding separate nine-job native workbook evidence remains dated and scoped.
Automatic context compaction and production native adoption remain disabled/unqualified.
This covers targeted table interactions, not all UI, accessibility, voice, media, hardware or search scale.
Native idle-only unload still needs an active-memory-pressure reproduction and recovery policy.
